name: Stowe Mountain Resort

Search summary (2026-09-30): highest lift-served skiing 3,625 ft (1,105 m) and 2,360 ft (719 m) vertical; Mt. Mansfield summit 4,395 ft (Vermont's highest). Base (386 m) derived as top minus vertical.

weatherPoints.label: Mount Mansfield lift-served top near the Nose (approx.)

source.note: Search summary (2026-09-30), current published figures: 116 trails, 12 lifts, 485 acres on Mt. Mansfield and Spruce Peak (linked by the Over Easy gondola). Split 16% beginner / 55% intermediate / 29% expert (published as three bands; the third is stored as advanced). Lifts: Over Easy transfer gondola, the high-speed summit Gondola, 4 high-speed quads, 2 triples, 2 doubles, 2 surface lifts. Average snowfall 314 in.

Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered' snowmakingPct (83%) from a 2026-09-30 search summary of Stowe's mountain-info page; the other flags remain reference data.

character: A large northern Vermont resort on Mount Mansfield, the state's highest peak, operated by Vail Resorts. Spruce Peak, across the Mountain Road, holds the base village and much of the easier terrain.
learning: Reference note: beginner and children's lessons are based on the Spruce Peak side. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson products.

season.notes: No confirmed 2026-27 opening date on file as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Nov 20, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Vail Resorts released its 2026/27 opening dates on Aug 18, 2026, but the search summary did not show Stowe's date — check the release (More links). For reference, Okemo, Stowe and Mount Snow targeted Sat Nov 22, 2025 for 2025-26 (announced Oct 29, 2025) — a target, not a confirmed opening day.

prices.note: Aggregator (snowstash.com): 2026/27 day tickets from $169, peak $239. Vail prices vary by date and advance purchase. Confirm at source.
